paragraphs.sourceText: How Marconi Gave Us the Wireless World
paragraphs.translationZh: 马可尼如何为我们带来无线世界

paragraphs.sourceText: A) A hundred years before iconic figures like Bill Gates and Steve Jobs permeated our lives, an Irish­ Italian inventor laid the foundation of the communication explosion of the 21st century. Guglielmo Marconi was arguably the first truly global figure in modern communication. Not only was he the first to communicate globally, he was the first to think globally about communication. Marconi may not have been the greatest inventor of his time, but more than anyone else, he brought about a fundamental shift in the way we communicate.
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 在比尔·盖茨和史蒂夫·乔布斯等标志性人物渗透到我们的生活之前一百年，一位爱尔兰裔意大利发明家为 21 世纪的通讯爆炸奠定了基础。古列尔莫·马可尼可以说是现代传播领域第一位真正的全球人物。他不仅是第一个进行全球沟通的人，而且是第一个从全球角度思考沟通问题的人。马可尼可能不是他那个时代最伟大的发明家，但他比任何人都更深刻地改变了我们的沟通方式。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) Today's globally networked media and conimunication system has its origins in the 19th century, when, for the first time, messages were sent electronically across great distances. The telegraph, the -telephone, and radio were the obvious predecessors of the-Internet, -iPotls, and-mobile phones. What made the link from then to now was the development of wireless communication. Marconi was the first to develop and perfect this system, using the recently-discovered "air waves" that make up the electromagnetic spectrum.
paragraphs.translationZh: B) 当今的全球网络媒体和通讯系统起源于 19 世纪，当时信息首次以电子方式远距离发送。电报、电话和无线电显然是互联网、智能手机和移动电话的前身。从那时到现在，无线通信的发展使这一联系得以实现。马可尼是第一个开发和完善该系统的人，利用最近发现的构成电磁频谱的“空气波”。

paragraphs.sourceText: C) Between 1896, when he applied for his first patent in England at the age of 22, and his death in Italy in 1937, Marconi was at the center of every major innovation in electronic communication. He was also a skilled and sophisticated organizer, an entrepreneurial innovator, who mastered the use of corporate strategy, media relations, government lobbying, international diplomacy, patents, and prosecution. Marconi was really interested in only one thing: the extension of mobile, personal, long­ distance communication to the ends of the earth ( and beyond, if we can believe some reports) . Some like to refer to him as a genius, but if there was any genius to Marconi it was this vision.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 从 1896 年 22 岁在英国申请第一项专利到 1937 年在意大利去世，马可尼一直处于电子通信领域每一项重大创新的中心。他还是一位熟练而老练的组织者、企业家创新者，精通企业战略、媒体关系、政府游说、国际外交、专利和起诉的运用。马可尼真正感兴趣的只有一件事：将移动、个人、长距离通信扩展到地球的两端（甚至更远，如果我们相信一些报道的话）。有些人喜欢称他为天才，但如果说马可尼有什么天才的话，那就是他的愿景。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) In 1901 he succeeded in signaling across the Atlantic, from the west coast of England to Newfoundland in the USA, despite the claims of science that it could not be done. In 1924 he convinced the British government to encircle the world with a chain of wireless stations using the latest technology that he had devised, shortwave radio. There are some who say Marconi lost his edge when commercial broadcasting came along; he didn't see that radio could or should be used to frivolous (::JGJMJ(ID) ends. In one of his last public speeches, a radio broadcast to the United States in March 1937, he deplored that broadcasting had become a one-way means of communication and foresaw it moving in another direction, toward communication as a means of exchange. That was visionary genius.
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 1901 年，他成功地从英格兰西海岸到美国纽芬兰，跨越大西洋发出信号，尽管科学声称这是不可能做到的。 1924 年，他说服英国政府使用他发明的最新技术——短波无线电——建立一系列无线电台，覆盖全世界。有人说，商业广播出现后，马可尼就失去了优势。他没有看到广播可以或应该被用来达到无聊的目的。在他最后的一次公开演讲中，即 1937 年 3 月向美国广播的广播中，他对广播已经成为一种单向的沟通方式表示遗憾，并预见到它会朝着另一个方向发展，将沟通作为一种交换手段。这是有远见的天才。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) Marconi's career was devoted to making wireless communication happen cheaply, efficiently, smoothly, and with an elegance that would appear to be intuitive and uncomplicated to the user-user­ friendly, if you will. There is a direct connection from Marconi to today's social media, search engines, and program streaming that can best be summed up by an admittedly provocative exclamation: the 20th century did not exist. In a sense, Marconi's vision jumped from his time to our own.
paragraphs.translationZh: E) 马可尼的职业生涯致力于使无线通信变得廉价、高效、顺畅，并且如果您愿意的话，它的优雅对于用户来说似乎是直观且简单的。马可尼与当今的社交媒体、搜索引擎和节目流之间存在着直接的联系，这可以用一句无可否认的挑衅性感叹来最好地概括：20 世纪并不存在。从某种意义上说，马可尼的视野从他的时代跳到了我们的时代。

paragraphs.sourceText: F) Marconi invented the idea of global communication-or, more straightforwardly, globally networked, principal communication technology of his day. Marconi was the first to develop a practical method for wireless telegraphy using radio waves. He borrowed technical details from many sources, but what set him apart was a self-confident vision of the power of communication technology on the one hand, and, on the other, of the steps that needed to be taken to consolidate his own position as a player in that field. Tracing Marconi's lifeline leads us into the story of modern communication itself. There were other important figures, but Marconi towered over them all in reach, power, and influence, as well as in the grip he had on the popular imagination of his time. Marconi was quite simply the central figure in the emergence of a modern understanding of communication.

G) In his lifetime, Marconi foresaw the development of television and the fax machine, GPS, radar, and the portable hand-held telephone. Two months before he died, newspapers were reporting that he was working on a "death ray," and that he had "killed a rat with an intricate device at a distance of three feet." By then, anything Marconi said or did was newsworthy. Stock prices rose or sank according to his pronouncements. If Marconi said he thought it might rain, there was likely to be a run on umbrellas.
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 在他的一生中，马可尼预见到了电视、传真机、GPS、雷达和便携式手持电话的发展。在他去世前两个月，报纸报道说他正在研究“死亡射线”，并且“用复杂的装置在三英尺外杀死了一只老鼠”。到那时，马可尼所说或所做的任何事情都具有新闻价值。股价根据他的言论上涨或下跌。如果马可尼说他认为可能会下雨，那么很可能会出现抢购雨伞的情况。

paragraphs.sourceText: H) Marconi's biography is also a story about choices and the motivations behind them. At one level, Marconi could be fiercely autonomous and independent of the constraints of his own social class. On another scale, he was a perpetual outsider. Wherever he went, he was never "of" the group; he. was always the "other," considered foreign in Britain, British in Italy, and "not American" in the United States. At the same time, he also suffered tremendously from a need for acceptance that drove, and sometimes stained, every one of his relationships.
paragraphs.translationZh: H) 马可尼的传记也是一个关于选择及其背后动机的故事。在某种程度上，马可尼可以高度自治并独立于他自己的社会阶层的限制。从另一个层面来说，他永远是一个局外人。无论他走到哪里，他都不是这个群体的“成员”；他。总是“他者”，在英国被认为是外国人，在意大利被认为是英国人，在美国则被认为是“非美国人”。与此同时，他也因需要被接受而承受着巨大的痛苦，这种需要推动着，有时甚至玷污了他的每一份人际关系。

paragraphs.sourceText: I) Marconi placed a permanent stamp on the way we live. He was the first person to imagine a practical application for the wireless spectrum, and to develop it successfully into a global communication system-in both terms of the word; that is, worldwide and all-inclusive. He was able to do this because of a combination of factors-most important, timing and opportunity-but the single-mindedness and determination with which he carried out his self-imposed mission was fundamentally character-based; millions of Marconi's contemporaries had the same class, gender, race, and colonial privilege as he, but only a handful did anything with it. Marconi needed to achieve the goal that was set in his mind as an adolescent; by the time he reached adulthood, he understood, intuitively, that in order to have an impact he had to both develop an independent economic base and align himself with political power. Disciplined, uncritical loyalty to political power became his compass. for the choices he had to make.
paragraphs.translationZh: I) 马可尼在我们的生活方式上留下了永久的印记。他是第一个设想无线频谱实际应用的人，并将其成功开发成全球通信系统——无论是在世界范围内还是在全球范围内。也就是说，全世界范围内的、包罗万象的。他能够做到这一点是由于多种因素的结合——最重要的是时机和机会——但他执行自我赋予的使命时的一心一意和决心从根本上来说是基于性格的；数以百万计的马可尼同时代人与他拥有相同的阶级、性别、种族和殖民特权，但只有少数人对此有所作为。马可尼需要实现他青少年时期就设定的目标；当他成年时，他直觉地明白，为了产生影响，他必须发展独立的经济基础并与政治权力保持一致。遵守纪律、不加批判地忠于政治权力成为他的指南针。为了他必须做出的选择。

paragraphs.sourceText: J) At the same time, Marconi was uncompromisingly independent intellectually. Shortly after Marconi's death, the nuclear physicist Enrico Fermi-soon to be the developer of the Manhattan Project-wrote that Marconi proved that theory and experimentation were complementary features of progress. "Experience can rarely, unless guided by a theoretical concept, arrive at results of any great significance ... on the other hand, an excessive ·trust in theoretical conviction would have prevented Marconi from persisting in experiments which were destined t0 bring about a revolution in the technique of radio-communications." In other words, Marconi had the advantage of not being burdened by preconceived assumptions.
paragraphs.translationZh: J) 与此同时，马可尼在思想上具有毫不妥协的独立性。马可尼去世后不久，核物理学家恩里科·费米（即将成为曼哈顿计划的开发者）写道，马可尼证明了理论和实验是进步的互补特征。 “除非有理论概念的指导，否则经验很少能得出任何具有重大意义的结果……另一方面，对理论信念的过度信任会阻止马可尼坚持进行注定要带来无线电通信技术革命的实验。”换句话说，马可尼的优势在于不受先入为主的假设的影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: K) The most controversial aspect of Marconi's life-and the reason why there has been no satisfying biography of Marconi until now-was his uncritical embrace of Benito Mussolini. At first this was not problematic for him. But as the regressive ( fftliJH1g) nature of Mussolini's ·regime became clear, he began to suffer a crisis of conscience. However, after a lifetime of moving within the circles of power, he was unable to break with authority, and served Mussolini faithfully ( as president of Italy's national research council and royal academy, as well as a member of the Fascist Grand Council) until the day he died-conveniently-in 1937, shortly before he would have had to take a stand in the conflict that consumed a world that he had, in part, created.
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 马可尼一生中最具争议性的方面——也是迄今为止没有令人满意的马可尼传记的原因——是他对贝尼托·墨索里尼不加批判的拥抱。起初这对他来说并不是问题。但随着墨索里尼政权的倒退本质变得明显，他开始遭受良心危机。然而，在权力圈子里混了一辈子后，他无法与权威决裂，并忠实地为墨索里尼服务（作为意大利国家研究委员会和皇家学院的院长，以及法西斯大委员会的成员），直到他于 1937 年去世的那一天——方便地——就在他不得不在这场冲突中表明立场之前，这场冲突吞噬了他部分创造的世界。

paragraphs.sourceText: 36. Marconi was central to our present-day understanding of communication.
paragraphs.translationZh: 36. 马可尼是我们当今对传播的理解的核心。

paragraphs.sourceText: 37. As an adult, Marconi had an intuition that he had to be loyal to politicians in order to be influential.
paragraphs.translationZh: 37. 作为一个成年人，马可尼有一种直觉，他必须忠于政客才能有影响力。

paragraphs.sourceText: 38. Marconi disapproved of the use of wireless communication for commercial broadcasting.
paragraphs.translationZh: 38. 马可尼不赞成使用无线通信进行商业广播。

paragraphs.sourceText: 39. Marconi's example demonstrates that theoretical concepts and experiments complement each other in making progress in science and technology.
paragraphs.translationZh: 39. 马可尼的例子表明，理论概念和实验在科学技术进步方面是相辅相成的。

paragraphs.sourceText: 40. Marconi's real interest lay in the development of worldwide wireless communication:
paragraphs.translationZh: 40. 马可尼的真正兴趣在于全球无线通信的发展：

paragraphs.sourceText: 41. Marconi spent his whole life making wireless communication simple to use.
paragraphs.translationZh: 41. 马可尼一生致力于让无线通信变得简单易用。

paragraphs.sourceText: 42. Because of his long-time connection with people in power, Marconi was unable to cut himself off from the fascist regime in Italy.
paragraphs.translationZh: 42. 由于与当权者的长期联系，马可尼无法将自己与意大利法西斯政权割裂开来。

paragraphs.sourceText: 43. In his later years, Marconi exerted a tremendous influence on all aspects of people's life.
paragraphs.translationZh: 43. 马可尼晚年对人们生活的各个方面产生了巨大的影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: 44. What connected the 19th century and our present time was the development of wireless communication.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44. 连接 19 世纪和当今时代的是无线通信的发展。

paragraphs.sourceText: 45. Despite his autonomy, Marconi felt alienated and suffered from a lack of acceptance.
paragraphs.translationZh: 45. 尽管马可尼拥有自主权，但他仍感到疏远，并因缺乏接受而感到痛苦。

paragraphs.sourceText: Humans are fascinated by the source of their failings and virtues. This preoccupation inevitably leads to an old debate: whether nature or nurture moulds us more. A revolution in genetics has poised this as a modern political question about the character of our society: personalities are hard-wired into our genes what can governments do to help us? It feels morally questionable, yet claims of genetic selection by intelligence are making headlines. This is down to “hereditarian” (遗传论的) science and a recent paper claimed “udifferences in exam performance between pupils attending selective and non-selective schools mirror the genetic differences between them”. With such an assertion, the work was predictably greeted by a lot of absurd claims about “genetics determining academic success”. What the research revealed was the rather less surprising result: the educational benefits of selective schools largely disappear once pupils' inborn ability and socio-economic background were taken into account. It is a glimpse of the blindingly obvious-and there's nothing to back strongly either a hereditary or environmental argument. Yet the paper does say children are “unintentionally genetically selected” by the school system. Central to hereditarian science is a tall claim: that identifiable variations in genetic sequences can predict an individual's aptness to learn, reason and solve problems. This is problematic on many levels. A teacher could not seriously tell a parent their child has a low genetic tendency to study when external factors clearly exist. Unlike-minded academics say the inheritability of human traits is scientifically unsound. At best there is a weak statistical association and not a causal link between DNA and intelligence. Yet sophisticated statistics are used to create an intimidatory atmosphere of scientific certainty. While there's an undoubted genetic basis to individual difference, it is wrong to think that socially
paragraphs.translationZh: 人类对自己的缺点和美德的根源着迷。这种关注不可避免地引发了一场老生常谈的争论：到底是先天因素还是后天因素更能塑造我们。遗传学革命将此作为一个关于我们社会特征的现代政治问题：个性是与我们的基因紧密相连的，政府可以做些什么来帮助我们？这在道德上令人怀疑，但智力基因选择的主张却成为头条新闻。这归因于“遗传论”科学，最近的一篇论文声称“选择性学校和非选择性学校学生之间考试成绩的差异反映了他们之间的遗传差异”。有了这样的断言，这项工作不出所料地受到了许多关于“遗传学决定学业成功”的荒谬说法的欢迎。研究揭示的结果并不令人意外：一旦考虑到学生的先天能力和社会经济背景，精英学校的教育效益就基本上消失了。这是对显而易见的事实的一瞥——而且没有任何东西可以有力地支持遗传或环境论点。然而该论文确实表示，儿童是学校系统“无意中进行基因选择的”。遗传科学的核心是一个崇高的主张：基因序列中可识别的变异可以预测个体学习、推理和解决问题的能力。这在很多层面上都是有问题的。当外部因素明显存在时，老师不能认真地告诉家长他们的孩子学习遗传倾向较低。持不同观点的学者表示，人类特征的可遗传性在科学上是不合理的。 DNA 和智力之间充其量只是微弱的统计关联，而不是因果关系。然而，复杂的统计数据被用来营造一种科学确定性的恐吓氛围。虽然个体差异无疑有遗传基础，但认为社会差异是错误的

paragraphs.sourceText: defined groups can be genetically accounted for. The fixation on genes as destiny is surely false too. Medical predictability can rarely be based on DNA alone; the environment matters too. Something as complex as intellect is likely to be affected by many factors beyond genes. If hereditarians want to advance their cause it will require more balanced interpretation and not just acts. of advocacy.

paragraphs.sourceText: Genetic selection is a way of exerting influence over others, "the ultimate collective control of human destinies," as writer H. G. Wells put it. Knowledge becomes power and power requires a sense of responsibility. In understanding cognitive ability, we must not elevate discrimination to a science; allowing people to climb the ladder of life only as far as their cells might suggest. This will need a more sceptical eye on the science. As technology progresses, we all have a duty to make sure that we shape a future that we would want to find ourselves in.
paragraphs.translationZh: 基因选择是对他人施加影响的一种方式，正如作家 H. G. 威尔斯所说，“人类命运的最终集体控制”。知识变成力量，而力量需要责任感。在理解认知能力时，我们不能把歧视上升为一门科学；允许人们只按照细胞的指示攀登生命的阶梯。这需要对科学持更加怀疑的态度。随着技术的进步，我们都有责任确保塑造一个我们想要的未来。

paragraphs.sourceText: Nicola Sturgeon's speech last Tuesday setting out the Scottish government's legislative programme for the year ahead confirmed what was already pretty clear. Scottish councils are set to be the first in the UK with the power to levy charges on visitors, with Edinburgh likely to lead the way.
paragraphs.translationZh: 尼古拉·斯特金上周二的讲话阐述了苏格兰政府未来一年的立法计划，证实了已经相当明确的事情。苏格兰议会将成为英国第一个有权向游客征收费用的议会，爱丁堡可能会带头。

paragraphs.sourceText: Tourist taxes are not new. The Himayalan kingdom of Bhutan has a longstanding policy of charging visitors a daily fee. France's tax on overnight stays was introduced to assist thermal spa (t'lffi.jl) towns to develop, and around half of French local authorities use it today.
paragraphs.translationZh: 旅游税并不是什么新鲜事。喜马拉雅山不丹王国长期以来有向游客收取每日费用的政策。法国引入过夜住宿税是为了帮助温泉 (t'lffi.jl) 城镇的发展，目前大约一半的法国地方当局正在使用该税。

paragraphs.sourceText: But such levies are on the rise. Moves by Barcelona and Venice to deal with the phenomenon of "over-tourism" through the use of charges have recently gained prominence. Japan and Greece are among the countries to have recently introduced tourist taxes.
paragraphs.translationZh: 但此类税收正在增加。巴塞罗那和威尼斯通过收费来应对“过度旅游”现象的举措最近受到关注。日本和希腊是最近开征旅游税的国家之一。

paragraphs.sourceText: the opposition to taxes and regulation of our aggressively pro-market ruling party. Some UK cities have lobbied without success for the power to levy a charge on visitors. Such levies are no universal remedy as the amounts raised would be tiny compared with what has been taken away by central government since 2010. Still, it is to be hoped that the Scottish government's bold move will prompt others to act. There is no reason why visitors to the UK, or domestic tourists on holiday in hotspots such as Cornwall, should be exempt from taxation-particularly when vital local services including waste collection, park maintenance and arts and culture spending are under unprecedented strain.
paragraphs.translationZh: 我们积极支持市场的执政党反对税收和监管。英国一些城市曾游说政府有权向游客收费，但没有成功。此类征税并不是万能的补救措施，因为与中央政府自 2010 年以来征收的金额相比，筹集的金额微乎其微。不过，人们希望苏格兰政府的大胆举措将促使其他国家采取行动。前往英国的游客或在康沃尔郡等热点地区度假的国内游客没有理由免税——特别是当包括废物收集、公园维护以及艺术和文化支出在内的重要当地服务面临前所未有的压力时。

paragraphs.sourceText: On the contrary, compelling tourists to make a financial contribution to the places they visit beyond their personal consumption should be part of a wider cultural shift. Westerners with disposable incomes have often behaved as if they have a right to go wherever they choose with little regard for the consequences. Just as the environmental harm caused by aviation and other transport must come under far greater scrutiny, the social cost of tourism must also be confronted. This includes the impact of short-term lets on housing costs and quality of life for residents. Several European capitals, including Paris and Berlin, are leading a campaign for tougher regulation by the European Union. It also includes the impact of overcrowding, litter and the kinds of behaviour associated with noisy parties.
paragraphs.translationZh: 相反，迫使游客在个人消费之外为他们所参观的地方做出经济贡献应该是更广泛的文化转变的一部分。拥有可支配收入的西方人常常表现得好像他们有权去任何他们选择的地方，而不考虑后果。正如航空和其他运输造成的环境危害必须受到更严格的审查一样，旅游业的社会成本也必须受到重视。这包括短期出租对居民住房成本和生活质量的影响。包括巴黎和柏林在内的多个欧洲国家首都正在带头发起一场要求欧盟加强监管的运动。它还包括过度拥挤、乱扔垃圾以及与喧闹聚会相关的各种行为的影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: There is no "one size fits all" solution to this problem. The existence of new revenue streams for some but not all councils is complicated, and businesses are often opposed, fearing higher costs will make them uncompetitive. But those places that want them must be given the chance to make tourist taxes work.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对于这个问题，没有“一刀切”的解决方案。对于一些议会（但不是所有议会）来说，新收入来源的存在很复杂，企业常常表示反对，担心更高的成本会使它们失去竞争力。但那些需要旅游税的地方必须有机会让旅游税发挥作用。
